# AfterTasteBlog

> > Retrogusti dal futuro: A bilingual Italian food blog exploring recipes, cocktails, restaurant reviews, and culinary travels across Italy and beyond.

AfterTasteBlog is a personal food blog by Simone Franco and contributors, featuring authentic regional Italian recipes (especially from Calabria, Puglia, and Sicily), creative cocktail recipes, restaurant reviews from cities like Bologna, Istanbul, and Lisbon, and culinary travel stories that blend tradition with modern experimentation.

## Key Topics

- Italian regional cuisine
- Cocktail recipes and mixology
- Restaurant reviews (Bologna, Istanbul, Lisbon)
- Calabrian and Apulian traditions
- Turkish cuisine (Pandeli, Çiya Sofrası)
- Sicilian ingredients and dishes
- Tenerife cocktail culture
- Traditional Christmas sweets
- Fusion recipes (Panettabka)
- Wine tasting in Trentino
- Authentic Roman pasta
- Seasonal fruit desserts
- Family recipes from grandmothers

## About AfterTasteBlog

- [AfterTasteBlog - Retrogusti dal futuro](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en): Homepage: Food blog featuring recipes, travel, and restaurant reviews
- [Simone Franco - BIOGRAFIA](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/simone-franco-biografia): Biography of Simone Franco, food blogger and AfterTasteBlog contributor

## Restaurant Reviews & Culinary Travel

- [The 4 food places to be in Lisbon](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/the-4-food-places-to-be-in-lisbon): Ashley's top 4 food spots in Lisbon: pasteis de nata to seafood
- [I due migliori ristoranti di Istanbul](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/i-due-migliori-ristoranti-di-istanbul): Guide to Istanbul's best Turkish restaurants: Pandeli and Çiya sofrasι
- [Manyi Sagami Bologna è il mio ristorante di fiducia](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/manyi-sagami-bologna-e-il-mio-ristorante-di-fiducia): Review of Manyi Sagami: Chinese-Japanese restaurant in Bologna
- [A cena da Secondo Tempo a Termini Imerese](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/a-cena-da-secondo-tempo-a-termini-imerese): Review of Secondo Tempo restaurant by chef Salvo Campagna in Sicily
- [La prima volta che mangiai una cacio e pepe](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/la-prima-volta-che-mangiai-una-cacio-e-pepe): Personal story of discovering authentic Roman cacio e pepe in Bologna
- [Cantina Martinelli: la perfetta deviazione](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/cantina-martinelli-la-perfetta-deviazione): Wine tasting at Cantina Martinelli in Mezzocorona, Trentino Dolomites

## Traditional Italian Recipes

- [Grandma Lina cooks priceless pasta with mussels](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/grandma-lina-cooks-priceless-pasta-with-mussels): Grandma Lina's Calabrian pasta with mussels recipe from Crotone
- [Apulian puccia bread with white onions and black olives](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/apulian-puccia-bread-with-white-onions-and-black-olives): Traditional Apulian puccia flatbread recipe with onions and olives
- [Dolci di Natale: vecchie e nuove tradizioni da ricordare](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/dolci-di-natale-vecchie-e-nuove-tradizioni-da-ricordare): Traditional Christmas sweets from Calabria and Puglia regions
- [Bye Bye Miss American (fruit) pie: my 'go-to' easy recipe](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/bye-bye-miss-american-fruit-pie-my-go-to-easy-recipe): Ashley's easy American fruit pie recipe with seasonal fruits
- [When panettone meets babka it's Panettabka time!](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/when-panettone-meets-babka-its-panettabka-time): Panettabka recipe: fusion of Italian panettone and babka for expats

## Cocktails & Mixology

- [A scuola di sidecar cocktail a Tenerife](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/a-scuola-di-sidecar-cocktail-a-tenerife): Personal sidecar cocktail recipe learned and reimagined in Tenerife
- [ChinoMark: il cocktail con whisky tra Kentucky e Sicilia](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/chinomark-il-cocktail-con-whisky-tra-kentucky-e-sicilia): ChinoMark cocktail recipe: Maker's Mark whisky meets Sicilian chinotto
- [Cocktail Marlena: un mix di intraprendenza e fortuna](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/cocktail-marlena-un-mix-di-intraprendenza-e-fortuna): Marlena cocktail creation story from bartending in Tenerife
- [Once upon a time, there was a glass of gin and tonic](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/en/once-upon-a-time-there-was-a-glass-of-gin-and-tonic): Personal journey from hating to loving gin and tonic with Bombay Sapphire

## Optional

- [L'infuso per chi non beve infusi è da Stregate Bologna](https://www.aftertasteblog.it/infuso-per-chi-non-beve-infusi-e-da-stregate-bologna): Review of Stregate Bologna tea shop and Mappa dei sogni infusion
